text: Ethics in AI is becoming an important topic as artificial intelligence plays a bigger role in our daily lives. One major concern is bias, because AI systems can learn unfair patterns from the data they are trained on. This can lead to decisions that are not fair, especially in areas like hiring or banking. Privacy is another key issue, since AI often collects and uses personal information. To build trust, companies need transparency, which means being open about how AI systems work and make decisions. Responsible AI development should focus on fairness, protect people's privacy, and make sure these powerful tools are used in a safe and honest way.
